Third-party code used by the Eden's Gate free tools (all run in your browser).

model-viewer.min.js   @google/model-viewer 3.4.0. Apache License 2.0. https://github.com/google/model-viewer
                      (includes three.js, MIT License, https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js)
shrink.js             bundle of glTF Transform 4.5.1 (MIT, https://github.com/donmccurdy/glTF-Transform)
                      and meshoptimizer 1.3.0 (MIT, https://github.com/zeux/meshoptimizer)
meshopt_decoder.js    meshoptimizer 1.3.0. MIT License. https://github.com/zeux/meshoptimizer
mp3-worker.js         lamejs (@breezystack/lamejs 1.2.7). GNU LGPL 3.0. Source: https://github.com/breezystack/lamejs
                      (based on https://github.com/zhuker/lamejs). You may replace this file with your own build of lamejs.
